messages.content: What are the latest movie releases?

function.name: calculate_velocity
function.description: Calculate the final velocity of an object in motion given its initial velocity, acceleration and time. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

initial_velocity.description: The initial velocity of the object in m/s. This is a float type value.

acceleration.description: The acceleration of the object in m/s^2. This is a float type value.

time.description: The time for which the object is in motion in seconds. This is a float type value.

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have real‑time access to current movie release schedules. If you let me know a specific region (e.g., U.S., UK, India) or a particular genre or studio you’re interested in, I can give you a general idea of what’s typically released around this time of year.
message.reasoning: User asks "What are the latest movie releases?" We need to respond with a list of movies. But we have no browsing capability. We can provide general info or ask clarifying question. According to policy, we cannot hallucinate. So we should ask for clarification or say we don't have up-to-date info. We can offer to search but we can't. So we should politely explain limitation.
